title: Melissa's ball of light from John Mack's Abduction

tellings.quote: cut to the 20th century Melissa in her early 20s saw a ball of light come through the sliding doors of her apartment bounce around the room go down the hall and into the other room

plain: A woman called Melissa, in her early twenties, saw a ball of light come through the sliding doors of her apartment, bounce around the room, go down the hall and into another room. The account comes from Abduction, a 1994 book by the researcher John Mack, who interviewed people who said they had met beings not from here. Jesse Michels retells it from the book, setting this modern case beside older religious visions to suggest they may be the same kind of experience.
